questions.prompt: A nit bets the river large. You have a medium pair. Best default?

choices.text: Fold. Their large bet is value.
Call. Medium pairs must hero-call nits
Call because the pot is big and ignore the size

questions.explanation: Pot odds matter, and a nit’s large river bet is still too strong for a medium pair most of the time.

questions.prompt: A loose, aggressive player bets small on the river. You have top pair. Best default?

choices.text: Call. You beat bluffs and worse value.
Fold top pair to any bet

questions.explanation: Small bets from aggressive players include bluffs. Top pair is a call, not an automatic raise.

questions.prompt: You have the second nuts and a tight player bets the river. Best default?

choices.text: Call, and raise only if worse hands will pay the raise.
Raise all-in with no worse hand that calls

questions.explanation: Do not fold a monster. Do not raise off the only worse hands that would have called a smaller bet if they will only call with better.

questions.prompt: You missed your draw and they bet the river. You should…

choices.text: Call because your draw was strong on the flop
Call if the draw was a flush draw

questions.explanation: The river ended the draw. No pair and no blocker plan is a fold to a bet.
